arabic text: SULAGTI RAIT PAY, SAJDAY KEE INTIHA DEKHI
english translation text: ON THE HOT BURNING SAND, THE MOST PROFOUND OF ALL PROSTRATIONS WAS WITNESSED

arabic text: SULAGTI RAIT PAY, SAJDAY KEE INTIHA DEKHI\nRASAN MAI VAARISAY TATHEER, BE RIDA DEKHI
english translation text: ON THE HOT BURNING SAND, THE MOST PROFOUND OF ALL PROSTRATIONS WAS WITNESSED,\nTHE INHERITOR OF PURITY (BIBI ZAINAB) WAS SEEN TIED IN ROPES, WITHOUT HER VEIL

arabic text: YEH SAJDA WO HAI KAY JISNAY, BACHAYA DEEN E KHUDA\nAGAR YEH SAJDA NA HOTA, TO KUCH BEE NAA HOTA\nISEE HEE SAJDAY MAI BUNYAAD E, LA ILA DEKHI
english translation text: THIS IS THE SAJDA THAT SAVED THE RELIGION OF ISLAM,\nALL WOULD HAVE BEEN LOST, IF IT WERE NOT FOR THIS SAJDA,\nTHIS SAJDA WAS THE FOUNDATION OF TAWHID

arabic text: KATAYA SAJDAY MAI SAR DEEN KI BAQAA KAY LIYE\nNA TAAJ O TAKHT KO DEKHA, NA MAAL O DOLAT KO\nFAQAT HUSSAIN (A.S) NAY ALLAH KI RAZAA DEKHI
english translation text: IMAM HUSSAIN SACRIFICED HIS HEAD IN PROSTRATION TO SAVE THE DEEN OF ISLAM,\nHE WAS NOT CONCERNED ABOUT POWER OR WEALTH,\nFOR HIM ONLY THE SATISFACTION OF ALLAH WAS FOREMOST

arabic text: LABON PAY SURAH E TATHEER, KEE SADAA DEKHI\nAJEEB WAQT THA KAY PATHRON KEE BAARISH MAI\nSINAA KEE NOAK PAY DEKHAA, QUR’AN KAY NAATIQ KO
english translation text: IT WAS A STRANGE SIGHT, IN THE MIDDLE OF STONES BEING PELTED,\nA HEAD ON A SPEAR WAS SEEN RECITING THE QUR’AN,\nTHE RECITATION OF SURAH TATHEER WAS HEARD FROM ITS LIPS

arabic text: SAJAAD (A.S.) KHOON NAA ROTA, TO AUR KYA KARTAA\nGHAYOOR QAIDEE NAI IN KHOON ALOOD ANKHON SAY\nKHARI HAZARON MAI TAFSEER E INAMA DEKHI
english translation text: WHAT ELSE WOULD SAJJAD HAVE DONE EXCEPT CRY TEARS OF BLOOD,\nTHE MORTIFIED PRISONER SAW WITH HIS BLEEDING EYES,\nHIS AUNT STANDING IN FRONT OF THOUSANDS IN THE COURT OF YAZID

arabic text: SARAAPA JOR KAY QASIM (A.S.), KA RO PARAY SYED (A.S.)\nHUSSAIN (A.S.) NAY JO KATAY HAATH, BE HINAA DEKHI\nUTHAA KAY LAASH KAY TUKRAY, RAKHAY IMAAMAY PAR
english translation text: HUSSAIN COLLECTED ALL THE PIECES OF QASSIM’S BODY\nAND PLACED THEM ON HIS TURBAN, WHEN HUSSAIN\nSAW THE SEVERED HANDS, HE WEPT A LOT,
